name: deepseek-search
description: Search the web and read pages through DeepSeek's own Search and Fetch APIs. A dependency-free stdio MCP server exposes deepseek_search (ranked results with title, URL, score, date, summary and optional page text) and deepseek_fetch (one page as Markdown), plus a Skill that teaches the search operators and the search-then-fetch workflow. The API key is read from the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable; no credential is stored in the package.
